newsitem.title: ITALY: Specialists bid for 56 bln lire of Italy CTZs.
newsitem.headline: Specialists bid for 56 bln lire of Italy CTZs.

text.p: Specialist bond traders bid for and were allotted 56 billion lire of two-year variable-rate zero coupon certificates (CTZ) against the Italian Treasury's offer of 250 billion lire of paper.
Earlier, the Treasury received bids for 2.777 trillion lire at the open auction for the October 31, 1998 paper, against 2.5 trillion lire worth of certificates on offer.
The auction price was set at 89.10 from 88.80 at the previous CTZ sale on November 12, with a gross yield falling to 6.17 percent from 6.24 percent.
